clarifications.need: Was 98% Devan's own score or the team's?
clarifications.whyItMatters: The role weights numbers that are yours rather than your queue's, and one satisfaction figure reads identically whether it describes this person or the six people around them.
clarifications.question: You mentioned 98% CSAT. Was that your own score or the team's?
probes: What was your own figure, if it differed from the queue's?
Over what period was it measured?

c1.headline: 98% is the six-person pod's queue average; their own is 96%
c1.answer: The 98% on the resume is the queue average for the six-person enterprise pod they sit in. Their own per-engineer score was 96%, across about forty-five surveys that came back.
c1.specifics: Whose number: the pod's, not theirs — six engineers on the enterprise queue. Their own figure: 96%. Sample: about forty-five returned surveys.
c1.still_unclear: What period the 96% covers, and whether it is measured the same way as the pod figure.
c1.quote: Ninety-six percent. That was across about forty-five surveys that came back.
